title: A conflict between "keyboard manager"&"grab and move"
author: crh380al2547

status.label: Win/Alt activation conflict is already tracked
status.detail: Using Win or Alt as Grab and Move's activation modifier suppresses Keyboard Manager shortcuts containing the same modifier. Open issues 47585 and 47812 already track the modifier-conflict behavior.

next_action.label: Consolidate under the existing modifier-conflict issues
next_action.reason: Do not post another generic evidence request or create a parallel design.

judgment.rationale: The report and confirmation are concrete, but the same Win-key conflict is already tracked in issue 47585 and triage explicitly identified issue 47812 as the same bug class.
evidence: The report states that disabling Grab and Move restores the Keyboard Manager remap.
A commenter confirms the same conflict with Alt.
Triage identifies issue 47812 as the same bug.
Issue 47585 is an open Grab and Move Win-key hotkey conflict tracker.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate reproduction evidence and any eventual fix under the existing modifier-conflict tracker.

fix_assessment.rationale: This issue is a duplicate/overlap of open modifier-conflict reports; no separate PowerToys fix should be designed here.

issue_context.summary: Using Win or Alt as Grab and Move's activation modifier suppresses Keyboard Manager shortcuts containing the same modifier. Open issues 47585 and 47812 already track the modifier-conflict behavior.
known_information: The conflict occurs when both modules consume the same activation modifier.
The failure is immediate and reversible by disabling Grab and Move.
Both Win and Alt variants are publicly confirmed.
inferences: Grab and Move's deliberate modifier absorption can prevent downstream Keyboard Manager handling, but the exact coordination policy should be decided on the canonical tracker.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is sufficiently understood for deduplication, not for another request-info action. Existing open trackers should own the cross-module design.
initial_investigation: Read the full body and all comments.
Checked issues 47585 and 47812 and confirmed both are open.
Inspected Grab and Move's modifier absorption and low-level hook path at a lightweight level.
